notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.

Trade is barley (HS 100300), customs gross weight. USDA PSD gives production, use, trade and stocks of marketing years; the customs table is a calendar year. Malting and feed barley are not told apart in the customs code; malt (HS 1107), barley flours and worked barley grains (HS 1104) are not loaded.

Price: the World Bank Pink Sheet has a monthly barley series that stops in August 2020; it is published to that month and marked closed. After it the price is the annual average of the World Bank's annual workbook, 2021 to 2025, a series of its own (nominal US dollars a tonne). The workbook does not say how its annual values after the monthly series are built. No monthly series after the Pink Sheet's was loaded.
